s1.title: Placing an order
s1.body: When you confirm checkout, the platform creates one order per shop. Each shop handles its own fulfillment. Please review items, address, and amounts before confirming.

s2.title: Payment and cash on delivery (COD)
s2.body: Bank transfer / PromptPay: pay the amount due and submit proof within the shop’s window. COD: pay in cash on delivery; a COD fee may apply as shown at checkout. Unpaid or overdue orders may be cancelled.

s3.title: Shipping
s3.body: Delivery time depends on the shipping method, stock, and destination. Keep your address and phone accurate. Shops may contact you to confirm details before dispatch.

s4.title: Refunds and cancellation
s4.body: Cancellations and refunds follow each shop’s policy and the order status. For damaged or incorrect items, contact the shop with evidence within the timeframe they specify.

s5.title: Personal data
s5.body: Name, address, and phone are used only to fulfill orders, shipping, and necessary contact. See each shop’s policy and the platform privacy policy for more detail.
